text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from millions of examples and then produce something new. Some people are amazed by this, while others are worried. They ask: can a machine really be creative? Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, however, follows patterns and data. So perhaps the best result is teamwork. Artists and writers can use AI as a helpful tool, not as a replacement. In the end, human creativity still leads the way.
